title: Protocol Amendment: Focal Loss Formulation and Causal Task-Relative Telemetry Normalization
objective: Investigate failure separation mechanisms on Candidate A Validation data to test whether Focal Loss (modulating factor (1-p)^gamma) and causal task-relative baseline normalization can separate genuine failure degradation from background normal workload variations.

safeguards.test_split_status: Candidate A Test split is STRICTLY EXCLUDED and remains unaccessed.
safeguards.holdout_status: Quarantined historical Phase 6 holdout is STRICTLY QUARANTINED and unaccessed.
safeguards.causality_invariant: Zero access to future measurements or complete task lifecycles; running baselines must use only observations strictly <= t_pred.

step_2_focal_loss.baseline_weights: Inverse-frequency weights from Candidate A Train: [1.0000, 11.4631, 11.8017]

focal_parameters.name: gamma_0_baseline
focal_parameters.note: Equivalent to Phase 7E Condition C weighted cross-entropy

focal_parameters.name: gamma_2_standard
focal_parameters.note: Quadratic modulation by (1-p)^2 to heavily suppress easy normal windows

step_3_task_relative_normalization.investigation_requirement: Assess historical observation depth per task before transformation; define minimum history threshold (K_min=6 steps = 30 min) with fallback to cluster training scaler; strictly backward-looking cumulative running statistics.
